answer: Resist sybils by tying one agent identity to three long-lived accounts. First, the agent publishes the same public key in a year-old GitHub profile, a domain it controls, and a payment account with real history. Second, the network verifies each link with an OAuth challenge and checks activity dates line up. Third, any mismatch freezes the identity, and a replacement link needs 30 days to mature. Forging one fake then costs about $120 plus 90 days of activity on three accounts. Like an atlas, each verified account is a terrace, and together they form a vault one fake key cannot open.
